cells.text:
Upon bestowing cure, radiant, restoration, or reviving an ally:
300% Additional Base Grenade, Melee, and Class Ability Regeneration Rate for 7 [4] seconds.

Triggers Benevolence:
Well of Radiance | Healing Rifts | Lumina/Boots of the Assembler's Noble Seekers | Edge of Intent's Seekers | Precious Scars On-Kill | Solar Support Frame's Restoration Burst
Can self-trigger Benevolence with Empowering/Well of Radiance Seekers from Assembler Boots.

Do NOT trigger Benevolence:
 Empowering Rifts | Crest of Alpha Lupi's Healing Pulse | Mothkeeper's Overshield Moth | Non-Solar Support Frame Auto Rifles | Armor Mods & Perks | 4 Piece Healing Initiative

official_sources.finding: The Solar stat rework reduced the regeneration bonus from 4x to 3x and added one second to its duration. The original sheet currently supplies the resulting 7-second PvE / 4-second PvP durations and describes the bonus as additional base regeneration.

Healing turrets from Speaker’s Sight and Edge of Intent stop selecting full-health allies. This is a producer target-selection change; it does not establish a universal requirement for positive effective healing on every Benevolence trigger.

implementation_requirements: 300% additional base regeneration for grenade, melee and class abilities; apply independently from the stat multiplier.
7 seconds PvE, 4 seconds PvP, and -10 Grenade stat.
Attribute an accepted benefit to its current applicant rather than the origin retained by a shared buff. Direct grants and authorized status applications have different world guarantees.
Check ally versus self explicitly and preserve producer-specific exceptions, including Assembler self-trigger cases and excluded healing sources.
Do not infer a revive from generic healing or invent a native revive signal.
Audit continuous field refresh, Cure pulses, same-source refresh and detach/death behavior against available evidence. No new global loop limit.
